intake.summary: ComfyUI node aggregator (3.9k stars, MIT top level) with no CUDA of its own: its .cu files are vendored NVIDIA-proprietary (EG3D bias_act), Tencent-licensed or generated slangtorch code, 47 files carry NVIDIA proprietary licence text, and its main GPU deps are licence-blocked (nvdiffrast, Inria diff-gaussian-rasterization) or already supported (spconv, torch-scatter, nerfacc).
